_readme: §PER-CITY-MEASUREMENTS (L-662) — the three EXPENSIVE C63 axes (LEGISLATION 25 · ENVELOPE 20 ·
HEIGHTS 10 = 55 % of the ratified weight) are AUDITS, not config reads, so computeScorecard.mjs
will not score them without a committed, reviewable measurement record. Absent ⇒ not-assessed.
This is the FIRST such record in the repo; before it, every city reported '—' on all three and
the board could not see work that had actually shipped.
⚠ `status: 'measured'` is the ONLY key that unlocks an axis. Never set it to make a number appear.
⚠ Every figure below is CITED to an artefact or a probe. INV-3: cited derivation, never a guess.

envelope.denominator: private buildable land = 75.145 M m² (L-656 — buildable land, NOT all land, NOT clicks)
envelope.source: tools/murcia-coverage-crosstab/out-crosstab.json (2026-08-01, run against the live Murcia GeoServer BEFORE the signature so the number could not be flattered by it)
note: Three NON-OVERLAPPING slices covering 100 % of the buildable denominator, so measuredShare = 1.0
and nothing is renormalised away. Derivation from the crosstab artefact:
packedAndDirect_pct 23.51  → a computed envelope RENDERS (§MURCIA-ENVELOPE-RENDER, SIG-MU1)
pgouDirect_pct 33.00 − 23.51 = 9.49  → PGOU orders it, PRYZM holds no usable rule (8.81 pp of
that is the single missing street-width source)
delegated_pct 67.00  → the PGOU expressly delegates (Arts. 5.24/5.25/5.26/6.2.2/6.5.1/6.6)
⚠ THE TIER IS THE AUTHORISATION, NOT A CHOICE. SIG-MU1 authorises `estimated-ruleset` (weight
0.4) and states `authoritative` is UNREACHABLE — a constructed determination caps at 0.70. So the
arithmetic maximum for this axis is 0.3300 × 0.4 ≈ 13.2 %, and today it is 0.2351 × 0.4 ≈ 9.4 %.
⚠ THE 67 % IS `not-determined`, AND THAT IS THE CORRECT SCORE, NOT A PENALTY. Those parcels reach
a TERMINAL state — a cited `derived-plan` refusal naming the governing article. Under the ratified
definition of CLOSED they are closed; they simply are not envelopes. C63 §1.5 / L-656: a refusal is
a correct answer, and a correct answer is not an envelope. Scoring it above 0 would claim coverage
the law does not grant.

coverage.zoneCode: packed-and-PGOU-direct (14 transcribed calificaciones on non-delegated soil)
PGOU-direct but unpacked (street-width-blocked 8.81 pp + 0.68 pp residual)
legally delegated to a derived instrument (cited refusal — terminal, never an envelope)

note: DENOMINATOR = 34, the buildable calificación FAMILIES the live Murcia GeoServer returns over the
30030 extent (classify.mjs BUILDABLE_FAMILIES = 14 packed + 8 genérica + 4 remitida + 8
refused-direct), NOT the 14 we authored. Scoring cited/authored would report 100 % — the
'Barcelona-borrow' trap C63 §3 Axis 2 names. 14/34 = 41.2 %.
⚠ documentInRepo: FALSE, and this is load-bearing (L-674). urbanismo.murcia.es/infourb/documentos/
returns HTTP 403 to automated requests (measured 2026-08-01 — the BCNROC pattern), so the
per-parameter verbatim quotes CANNOT be re-read from corpus/pdf/ the way Barcelona's DOGC 4893
can. The quotes may be perfect; nothing in the repo can currently prove it. C63 routes this to the
DATA-SOURCES axis rather than silently discounting LEGISLATION.
⚠ supersessionChecked: FALSE — the 2017 re-edition (196 pp, the version the municipality links
publicly) has NOT been diffed against the 2012 TR every quote came from. Concordance UNVERIFIED.
signedVerification TRUE reflects SIG-MU1 only; a signature is not a supersession audit.

heightsLod.source: tools/context-height-probe/probe.mjs against the SHIPPED R2 tiles (same bytes the browser reads, same provenance ladder) — 2026-08-01, verdict `unmeasured`
note: ⚠ measured-lidar = 0. Murcia is the WORST of the five Spanish cities: 96.1 % of its context
buildings render a FABRICATED 9 m default. The 86 `tagged` are OSM-surveyed heights, not MDS
samples — no measured-lidar marker exists anywhere in the city's shipped tiles.
ROOT CAUSE FOUND AND FIXED 2026-08-01: Murcia was absent from heightSources.mjs MDS_CITY_BBOXES,
which is BOTH the join's priorityBboxes AND its retainBboxes working set (L-659). Footprints
outside the retain set stream through untouched, so Murcia could never have been stamped — and a
national bake would still have reported a GREEN §MEASURED-HEIGHT-GATE for the `spain` region.
⚠ THIS RECORD IS A PRE-BAKE BASELINE, DELIBERATELY. A buildings re-bake is in flight; re-probe and
update this block after it publishes. Do NOT edit these counts to predict the outcome
(§SIZE-IS-NOT-PROVENANCE — a green bake is precisely what L-658 produced while shipping nothing).
